# FlareRibbon

`Flare.Components.IDE.FlareRibbon`

Ribbon component with tabbed command groups. Each FlareRibbonTab child defines a tab containing FlareRibbonGroup groups of commands. Composed entirely from base Flare CSS classes - no custom tokens.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Ribbon tabs rendered inside the ribbon bar. |
| `OnTabChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` | `` | Callback |  | Callback fired when the active tab changes. The parameter is the tab title. |
| `SizeMode` | `RibbonSizeMode` | `RibbonSizeMode.Full` | Parameter |  | Current ribbon size mode - full (default) shows commands, collapsed shows only tabs. |
| `AdditionalAttributes` | `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional attributes. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |

## Methods

### `DisposeAsync()`

Disposes the component; override to release JS interop or subscriptions.
Returns: `ValueTask`.

### `OnTabNavigation(string key, bool rtl)`

Moves to the next or previous enabled tab (Left/Right, mirrored in right-to-left text), or the first or last one (Home/End), opens it and focuses its tab. Called by the shared tab-keyboard script, which has already kept the browser from scrolling.
Returns: `Task`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | The navigation key. |
| `rtl` | `bool` | Whether the tab strip is laid out right to left. |
